# Sense & Forum®

> Sense & Forum® is a no-nonsense community-led marketing consultancy founded by Serena Kara Gasparini. We design community-led growth systems and provide senior marketing leadership across launch, go-to-market and growth.

Sense & Forum works with founders, startups and organisations to create marketing, community and growth systems that work for the people using them. Services include Fractional CMO support, community strategy, audits and redesign, building from scratch, and launch partnerships for startups and scale-ups entering new markets.

Every engagement is underpinned by The DELIA Model™, the methodology created by founder Serena Kara Gasparini for designing programmes, communities and growth systems that hold women instead of asking them to fit in.

FemNEST, a financial wellness platform, is a separate venture founded by Serena Kara Gasparini and is not part of Sense & Forum.

## Founder

Serena Kara Gasparini
https://serenagasparini.com

Serena is a Fractional CMO and Community-Led Marketing Strategist with two decades of experience across marketing, events and community. She founded Sense & Forum® and created The DELIA Model™.

## Services

- Fractional CMO
- Community-Led Marketing
- Community Strategy
- Audit and Redesign
- Go-to-Market Strategy
- Launch Partner
- Building Communities From Scratch
- Growth Marketing
- Product and Service Launches
- Entering New Markets
- Programme and Community Design

## Methodology

The DELIA Model™: Diverse, Emotionally Safe, Life-Centred, Inclusive, Accessible.

Created by Serena Kara Gasparini, it underpins the work delivered through Sense & Forum® and the work Serena advises on directly.
